method: Start from issuer-confirmed launched stablecoins not present in the current 120-row candidate-control history by exact-name/symbol search.

Do not promote from search absence alone. Before canonical implementation, compare each candidate against every stablecoin data group in the active Registry v2 baseline plus aliases, issuer identities and lineage relationships.
Planned or announced tokens are excluded unless launch/issuance is confirmed by an issuer-controlled source.

candidates.name: USA₮
source_backed_facts: Tether announced the official market launch on 2026-01-27.
Tether identifies Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. as issuer.
Anchorage lists USA₮ among its issued stablecoins and states its stablecoins are redeemable 1:1 for U.S. dollars on its platform with monthly reserve attestations.

candidates.name: EURO eXchange Token
source_backed_facts: Crédit Agricole and CACEIS announced the EURXT launch on 2026-07-01.
CACEIS identifies EURXT as an ERC-20 electronic money token issued on Ethereum and pegged 1:1 to euro.

The issuer whitepaper identifies CACEIS Bank as issuer and gives a public-offer/admission start date of 2026-06-01; the canonical launch boundary must distinguish that from the 2026-07-01 product launch announcement.

candidates.name: SoFiUSD
source_backed_facts: SoFi identifies SoFi Bank, N.A. as issuer.
SoFi states SoFiUSD is fully reserved 1:1 by cash and operates on a public permissionless blockchain.

candidates.name: USDGO
source_backed_facts: OSL announced the official launch on 2026-02-10.
OSL and Anchorage identify Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. as issuer and OSL as branding/distribution operator.
The initial issuance was US$50 million on Solana; OSL later reported circulating supply above US$500 million in June 2026.

candidates.name: U.S. Dollar Payment Token
source_backed_facts: Western Union announced the launch on 2026-05-04.
Western Union and Anchorage identify Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. as issuer and Solana as the launch network.
Western Union states USDPT is fully backed by U.S. dollars; Anchorage publishes monthly USDPT reserve attestations.

excluded_from_this_scan.name: XrymaCoin
excluded_from_this_scan.reason: Issuer announcement states circulation begins 2026-09-03, which is future-dated as of this review; not yet a launched canonical candidate.

excluded_from_this_scan.name: Qivalis euro stablecoin
excluded_from_this_scan.reason: Consortium materials describe a future second-half-2026 issuance; no launched token identity is yet established in the reviewed source.
